Video compression, explained.

How do I convert AVI to MP4 or MOV to MP4 for free?

Choose your AVI or MOV file, select quality and resolution, then click Compress & convert to MP4. Still creates an H.264 MP4 with AAC sound (or no sound if you choose Remove sound). Preview and download the result. There are no accounts, fees or watermarks.

Which settings make videos smaller?

Start with Balanced quality and up to 1080p. For a smaller file, choose Smaller file quality, reduce the resolution to 720p or 480p, or reduce a high frame rate to 30 fps. Removing audio also saves space. The final size depends on the length and content of the video, so a fixed size is not guaranteed. An already compressed video can become larger; Still tells you when that happens.

Will the video keep its original quality?

Video compression is lossy. Best detail preserves more visible detail at a larger size; Smaller file compresses more. MP4 output is 8-bit H.264, so it does not retain RAW video editing data or HDR range. HDR and Dolby Vision clips can have color or brightness differences; export an SDR version from your editor first for predictable color. Keep your originals and preview every important export.

Does it support every AVI, MOV or MKV file?

These are containers that can hold different codecs. Many common video and audio codecs work, but not every variant is supported. Only the first main video track and first audio track are exported; subtitles, chapters and extra tracks are omitted. Unsupported or damaged files produce an error. This tool handles photos separately and does not develop camera RAW video.

Why does conversion take time, especially on a phone?

All the work runs in your browser, using your device's processor and memory. The engine downloads about 32 MB on first use. Short clips and lower resolutions are easier to handle. Files are limited to 200 MB, and some phones may run out of memory with smaller files. Use a desktop browser for demanding clips. You can cancel immediately and try a smaller clip; jobs time out after 30 minutes.

Are my videos uploaded or stored anywhere?

No. Still reads and converts your video locally in this browser. Video contents are never uploaded. The site downloads its code from GitHub Pages and fonts from Google Fonts. Your export exists in this tab until you save it or close the tab. The conversion removes copied source metadata, but visible information inside the picture and sound remains.
